*   Added a "Final Save" button directly inside the hover controls of each image card. This button serves as a clear "confirm and export" action.
*   Improved the visual feedback of the "Save" action.

**Behavior**:
*   When dragging and formatting text, the editor accurately tracks its position.
*   Upon clicking "Final Save" or the "4K" button, the script precisely recreates the visual state onto a high-resolution canvas using the calculated ratio to prevent the "shrinking text" bug.
</feedback>
</response>
